exams.title: Pariksha Mock 01, JEE Main pattern
exams.description: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Multiple choice and numerical questions with negative marking on multiple choice.
instructions: The test is timed. The clock at the top right shows the time left. When it reaches zero your paper is submitted automatically.
Select a number in the question palette to jump to that question. Your answer is saved as soon as you choose it.
Use Save & Next to move on, Mark for Review & Next to flag a question you want to revisit, and Clear Response to remove your answer.
A question marked for review that already has an answer is still evaluated. A marked question without an answer is not.
For multiple choice questions, select an option. For numerical questions, type the value or use the on-screen keypad.
Stay in full-screen and do not switch tabs. Every exit is recorded and shown to the invigilator.
The marks for each question are shown above it. Some question types carry negative marking.
You can submit only once. After you submit, you cannot return to the paper.

questions.text: How many moles are present in 36 grams of water? Molar mass of water is 18 g/mol.
questions.explanation: Number of moles = mass / molar mass = 36 / 18 = 2 mol.

questions.explanation: At 25 degrees Celsius, a neutral aqueous solution has pH 7.

questions.explanation: H2SO4 contains 2 hydrogen atoms, 1 sulfur atom and 4 oxygen atoms. Total = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7.

questions.explanation: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is -b/a. Here it is 7.
